{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/sh
#flux: --job-name=prism
#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 24
#flux: -c 1
#flux: --time-limit=4h

# Note: PBS -V directive exports all environment variables, which is Flux default behavior.
# Note: PBS -q directive (exclusive) does not have a direct Flux equivalent.
# Performance consideration: Queue selection not preserved. Job may run on different queue/priority.
# Note: PBS -A directive (etc) does not have a direct Flux equivalent.
# Performance consideration: Account/project tracking not preserved.
# Note: PBS -l select requests 1 node with 68 CPUs, 24 MPI processes, and 1 OpenMP thread per process.
# Flux -N 1 specifies 1 node, -n 24 specifies 24 tasks, -c 1 specifies 1 core per task.
# Note: PBS ncpus=68 suggests 68 total cores, but mpiprocs=24 with ompthreads=1 uses only 24.
# Performance consideration: Full node CPU allocation (68 cores) not explicitly reserved.
# Note: PBS -m directive (abe) does not have a direct Flux equivalent.
# Performance consideration: Email notifications not available.
# Note: PBS -M directive (sylee2519@naver.com) does not have a direct Flux equivalent.
# Performance consideration: Email notifications not available.
# Note: PBS -W sandbox=PRIVATE does not have a direct Flux equivalent.
# Performance consideration: Job isolation/sandboxing behavior may differ.

cd $FLUX_JOB_SUBMIT_DIR
module purge
module load craype-x86-skylake gcc/7.2.0 openmpi/3.1.0
module load forge/18.1.2
module load cmake/3.17.4
module load python/3.7
module load tensorflow/1.12.0

export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1

python test2.py 1>stdout 2>stderr
"
}
